title: Uptake agent archiving in Sales Order Agent (AB#644549)
summary: The Sales Order Agent app now supports agent archiving, a soft delete capability that marks deactivated agents as read-only while preserving their data. Archived agents no longer consume instance slots, their identities and mailboxes can be reused by administrators, and the setup experience becomes read-only for archived agents.
key_points: Archived agents no longer count toward the 20-agent instance limit, freeing slots
Archived agent identities and mailboxes can be deliberately reused by administrators but are not auto-suggested
Setup pages become read-only for archived agents with explanatory notifications
Scheduled tasks are canceled when agents are deactivated to prevent orphaned execution
Upgrade processes skip archived agents to avoid repeated failures on write operations
